rationale: Given Sotomayor’s assignment power and the coalition’s emphasis on rejecting a domicile bright-line while adopting a cabined “U.S. enforcement nexus” test, she is the modal author, with Barrett/Kagan also plausible to craft administrable limits. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters to press a residence-based rule and from one or more majority members (especially Barrett/Kavanaugh/Gorsuch) to further narrow the nexus requirement to avoid “manufactured” domestic injury.
